summary.text: Rudy Recile is the Republican nominee for California's 8th Congressional District. A retired U.S. Army major with more than 26 years of service, he later worked for the U.S. Department of Agriculture and runs a small web business. He previously ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Recile was born in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. The Daily Republic reported in 2022 that he is a U.S. citizen of Filipino heritage and the son of a single immigrant mother who brought her family from the Philippines.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern Illinois University in 1995 and, per Ballotpedia, a graduate degree from National Graduate School in 2005.

He served in the U.S. Army from 1988 to 2014, with assignments in Illinois, South Korea and Washington, D.C., including time at the Pentagon, and retired as a major; his final duty station was in Fairfield, California.
The Daily Republic reported he worked as a logistician and project manager, and as a contract officer representative for the Army.

After retiring in 2014 Recile settled in California, worked as a USDA data manager and instructor in its Plant Protection and Quarantine division, and owns a web development business; his Ballotpedia candidate statement says his family has lived in Solano County for 18 years.

He has been affiliated with Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 2333 (Fairfield-Suisun), the National Rifle Association, the California Rifle and Pistol Association, and the Solano and Yolo County Republican central committees.
He ran for this seat in 2022 and 2024 and lost to Garamendi both times; in the June 2026 primary he finished second with 27.8%.
His campaign website links to a podcast, "Boot's on the Ground."
